title: Law to let officials block AI deepfakes of themselves
summary: This bill would let elected officials and candidates notify AI system owners that they do not authorize the creation of manipulated audio, photos or videos depicting them. After notice, AI providers would have 60 days before an election to implement measures blocking users from generating such deceptive media, or face a misdemeanor charge and fines up to $2,500 per depiction. Officials and candidates could also seek a court order to stop unauthorized use of their likeness.
